contact.basis: Open dry Honmaru courtyard east of main stone base, south of modern access tower and north of separate Honmaru Palace. This controls courtyard datum, not lower moat or upper stone cap.

verticalDatum: Official GSI elevation-tile heights; host-relative visualization. No local survey datum transformation or accuracy claim.

sourceSelection.method: First layer with all four valid interpolation pixels. NoData is never interpreted as zero or filled across gaps.

attribution: 国土地理院 地理院タイル (Geospatial Information Authority of Japan)
method: Original official RGB24 signed-centimetre tiles bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in the signed model frame. Bounded160m castle grid retains independent heights without flattening or fitting the building. Original source tile bytes are retained.
limitations: Tile pixel spacing and centimetre encoding are not survey accuracy. GSI tiles are interpolated elevation products.
Grid bounds include the building and dry approaches, not the distant city context or distant context. Other host terrain remains host-dependent.
